notes.title: Day-Night Cycle Update
notes.content: [p][b]Merlin SDK:[/b][/p][list][*][p]When creating maps in the SDK, you can specify lighting and sky presets to use at different times of day. In the VTT, Merlin interpolates between these presets while moving the sun's position.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Merlin also has default sky presets it will try to use if none have been set.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]You can also link custom blueprints to an event that runs whenever the time of day is changed, so you can create time-dependent scripts. For example: ambient noise in a forest that should sound different depending on whether it's day or night. Another example: in the Medieval Tavern demo map, we use this to change the level of fog during day or night.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Merlin VTT:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Control panel that lets the GM set the current time of day, and whether it should actively change.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Set to noon/night/dawn/dusk and total darkness presets, and a dial to set to a more specific time.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tick time forwards at variable speed or pause completely.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655043/4c16d55d2953107cb7d18ee76095aebdd42bb472.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Day Time Control Panel[/i][/p]

notes.title: More Small Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added separate video setting sliders for anti-aliasing mode and quality (very useful as mode has a very large impact on performance and quality, and previously was only adjustable as a side-effect of the "quality" preset).
[*]Fixed crash + some other issues with custom ports
[*]Fixed a bug where GM UI would not hide properly when possessing a character
[*]Fixed a bug where the mouse wouldn't show in the esc menu if in first/third person mode with the mouse hidden
[*]Added confirm box on "return to main menu" and "quit" buttons when in-game
[/list]

notes.title: Small Interaction and Lighting Update
notes.content: [p]While working on new maps, we ran up against a bunch of things that needed to be improved or fixed with Merlin's system for user-made interactable objects. In the video, you can see some new lighting assets we've made using these improvements:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="kr0bBILdG9Q;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Basically, making custom interactable objects like the lights in the video is now much easier, and that template can be used by map makers using the SDK.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655043/1811466def96df21c2546a00dd6cf40ead744ae0.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Some of the custom light switch options available to map makers using the SDK.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The interactable lights in the video are also available as default spawnable objects in the VTT itself, that can be spawned in any level.[/p][p]Next up, we are going to be adding day/night cycle controls, then releasing a couple of maps we've been working on in collaboration with some creators.[/p]

notes.title: Boring Update
notes.content: [h3]Merlin[/h3][list][*][p]Added compatibility with more tools for map makers: Nanite, Lumen, World Partition, Water Plugin[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added port customisation because some guy asked me to[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the video settings menu sometimes turning shadows off completely. Added some new video settings.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed the main menu always reverting back to 1280x720[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Removed a lot of unneeded content from the core packs[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Limited FPS in main menu to 60[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]SDK Lite 0.2.2 ([url="https://merlinvtt.com/sdk-latest"]Download Here[/url])[/h3][list][*][p]Added a way for creators to specify recommended video settings for their map, that users can automatically apply[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed thumbnails not being added to package[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added 'Log pak file' button - dumps contents of pak file to console[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Nothing very exciting here, just stuff I discovered was very necessary while making maps last week. Cooler stuff coming soon![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Foundry v12+ Compatibility Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed several things that were not working properly in Foundry v12 and above:

[list]
[*]Campaign launching not working consistently
[*]Sidebar UI looked messed up
[*]Connection and 'Admin Authenticated' indicators in the Foundry settings menu sometimes not displaying correctly
[*]Campaigns with large numbers of actors would fail to send them to Merlin
[*]Merlin not directing Foundry back to the setup page automatically in tandem with activating Merlin's main menu
[/list]

Also added a little popup asking players to please join the Discord and give us feedback and bug reports.

notes.title: Added Rotate and Scale Tools
notes.content: [p]We've added rotation and scale modes to the transform tool. You can switch between translate, rotate and scale mode by pressing 'R' when you have an object selected.[/p][p]We have a lot more improvements for this tool planned, but these seemed like a pretty vital thing to add that give GMs a lot more options, for minimal development effort.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655043/b9b8d4cc24a82b585eee0ef823cbe1884b24d588.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655043/0843b763889b3fae7d1d8542cbe8352f5e3d1564.png"][/img][/p][p][u]Other fixes:[/u][/p][list][*][p]Transform tool now clickable through other objects[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed server error message incorrectly showing when launching a game with only core packs[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Minor Main Menu Makeover
notes.content: [p]We've slightly improved the look of the campaign browser and settings menus. It still doesn't look great, but it's a lot better than it was, and I'm a lot happier with this as the first thing people see when they use Merlin for the first time. A good value improvement for like one day of work. Some pictures:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655043/0192190d3dfa1c7662e2331b9122f1730c67a196.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655043/152a5aee681c05c5f7628d2717dd1ef101a14268.png"][/img][/p][p]Still lots of UI that needs to be improved, but going to move on with other more useful stuff for now. Also, now that some work has been done on establishing a new UI style, it will be much easier to quickly improve other parts of the UI, and that work can be slotted in here and there while working on more important stuff.[/p]
